acceptance_gates.principle: Capstones reflect reality; they do not gate. The deliverable is validity of the schema, not a numeric threshold.

field_principles.arxiv_ready: True only if exp2553.arxiv_ready=True. This is the PRIMARY milestone success criterion. Directly read from exp2553; never inferred or softened.
field_principles.auroc_adversarially_verified: True only if best_245_auroc was produced by an artifact with >=3 seeds AND no flagged_adversarial entries. Phase-3 verifier-ensemble guarantee.
field_principles.best_245_auroc: Cite-safe headline AUROC. Carry-forward 0.9750 if ensemble v7b unavailable. Adversarially-flagged improvements are NOT cite-safe and do NOT replace the clean 5-seed ensemble result.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock measurement for the capstone synthesis itself.
field_principles.external_baselines: HIVE peer (0.9236, arXiv:2604.26139) carried forward for continuous gap tracking. Future .246 work will widen this list as comparator integration proceeds.
field_principles.gatemate_status: Hardware continuity tracking -- mirrors exp2551 GateMate record.
field_principles.hardware_terminal_states: Per-board state after exp2551. Hardware continuity discipline requires each attached board be tracked until terminal.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. Must start with complete:.
field_principles.jepa_discrimination_improved: True if exp2550.fast_path_rate in [0.30, 0.80]. Continuous self-learning milestone deliverable -- distinguishes useful from degenerate fast-path.
field_principles.kv260_status: Hardware continuity tracking -- mirrors exp2551 KV260 record.
field_principles.n_experiments_completed: Count of exp2543-exp2553 artifacts whose honest_verdict starts with a terminal prefix (complete:/success:/passed:/shipped:). Blocked verdicts do NOT count.
field_principles.operator_recommendation: submit_now / review_section_4_first / fix_latex / request_operator_decision. Drives the operator's next action; honesty about ambiguity matters.
field_principles.phase4_final_status: Terminal Phase 4 determination -- 'retired_negative_option_b' requires exp2544.phase4_section_expanded=true AND phase4_honest_negative_documented=true. 'blocked_precondition' otherwise. 'validated_clean' would require a Phase 4 validation artifact, which .245 did not attempt.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records which source artifacts were present and read.
field_principles.process_flags: Any non-terminal honesty signals collected from the source artifacts -- fabrication flags, malformed verdict prefixes, blocked-precondition tasks.
